renewed_from.description: The counter values at the last re-planning that re-entered execution (Phase Workflows Specification, Dynamic Re-Planning); the effective ceiling is counted from them. null before any renewal.

fix_used.description: Charged when the fix's commit or artifact exists; an unchanged artifact or an empty commit is refused fix_unchanged and not charged; an uncommitted fix whose commit call stepped out is not charged.

last_retry.description: The last retry and the failure fingerprints it answered; a retry with the same reason over the same fingerprints is refused retry_not_applicable.
